page: Alibaba Cloud ecs.r7a.32xlarge is an x86_64 architecture server instance powered by the KVM hypervisor. It features 128 dedicated physical cores and 128 vCPUs, indicating a configuration with one thread per core. The processing power is delivered by AMD EPYC 7T83 processors operating at a baseline frequency of 2.55 GHz.

This instance is configured with 1024.0 GB of system memory, yielding a memory-to-core ratio of 8.0 GB per vCPU. It does not include local storage, meaning all storage requirements must be met via network-attached block storage. Network connectivity is supported by a baseline bandwidth of 32 Gbps. The instance does not include any graphics processing units or complimentary public IPv4 addresses.

The ecs.r7a.32xlarge offers high memory density per vCPU, making it a viable option for memory-intensive workloads that do not require local NVMe storage or GPU acceleration. The dedicated CPU allocation ensures consistent processing performance without resource contention. This profile is suitable for large-scale databases, in-memory caching layers, enterprise resource planning systems, and memory-heavy data processing pipelines.
